# FRIDAY-OS — Agent Rules (the lean card)

> Canon for **every agent in every repo**. It's one screen — read all of it.
> Deliberately lean (2026-07-02): the *why*, mechanics and doctrine live in
> `$FRIDAY_VAULT/ACTIVE/system/AGENT_DOCTRINE.md`; per-incident history in
> `$FRIDAY_VAULT/ACTIVE/projects/<slug>/learnings.md`. Don't add prose here —
> propose rules to the Director; one line each.
> Root `AGENTS.md` symlinks here. Child repos carry a thin overlay pointing back here.

## Session start (in order)
1. `BOOT.md` / `friday://boot` — live state (generated; never edit)
2. `$FRIDAY_VAULT/ACTIVE/projects/<slug>/` — **brain.md** + **learnings.md** of what you're touching
3. GitHub Issues `label:task` — the only work queue

## The 20 hard rules

1. **Blocked? Stop and report.** Never invent a workaround, fallback, or new script around a block.
2. **Never work on `main`.** Branch first: `<agent>/<short-task>-<id>`.
3. **Never track build artifacts / generated files.** `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `*.log`, `*.jsonl`, `__pycache__/`, `.env*` (except `.env.example`) stay gitignored. **One exception: `memory/ROTATION_LOG.jsonl` is tracked** (Director, 2026-08-27) — it is an audit record, not a build output, and rule 5 reads credential age from it; it carries names and salted fingerprints only, never values.
4. **Never inline an auth check.** LeadFlow: `requireApiKey` middleware. Kernel: the gateway auth layer.
5. **One credential store, one clock.** Prod: `friday-secrets/*.env` (0600) loaded as a systemd `EnvironmentFile`; dev: env/`op run`. One path only — unavailable → fail with a clear error, never fall back. **Rotate within 30 days of issuance** (Director, 2026-08-20); age is read from `memory/ROTATION_LOG.jsonl`, never file mtime, and overdue is a `label:failure`. `systemd-creds` is the migration target, not today's requirement — #527.
6. **Never duplicate code.** `grep -r` first; extend what exists.
7. **No shims, re-exports, or back-compat aliases.** Rename/remove → update every caller.
8. **Never commit secrets.** No exceptions — Firebase dropped, we don't use it.
9. **Sealed files: ARCHIVE the old version, then edit the REAL file and bump.** Three steps, in order: (a) copy the outgoing version to `SOUL_<AGENT>_v<N>-<what-changed>-<date>.md` beside it — **the changelog lives in the archive title**; (b) edit the real file only — a SOUL is one real file + two symlinks (`docs/soul_versioning/`), and replacing a symlink with a copy reintroduces the drift the design prevents; (c) bump the H1 version and add a `## Version History` row. **`NEO-PROVENANCE` headers are informational until the ledger is rebuilt (task #13): there is no corpus to verify a seal against, so no reseal ceremony can currently check anything.** Precisely, as of 2026-08-29: `data/rag_index.db.documents` holds 3 rows — agent inbox handoffs from 2026-08-05, all with `chroma_id` and `collection` NULL — i.e. no corpus, not the empty table this rule used to claim. Chroma is retired as the corpus: `database-chromadb-friday` is up but holds one collection and a single embedding, there is no backup of it (the daily `/var/backups` job covers housing only), and the live corpus is `friday_brain.rag_*` on Supabase pgvector. When the vault+Supabase ledger lands this rule requires a re-seal again — and the hash stays OUT of the file.
10. **Brain + generated files serialize on `main`.** One brain PR at a time; never hand-merge `index.db`/`index.sql` — regenerate (registry: `generate_registry.py` + `sync_index_db.py` + `generate_state.py`).
11. **Never squash- or rebase-merge.** Real merge commits only (`merge_method: "merge"` / `git merge --no-ff`). Tidy messy commits on the branch, before merging.
12. **Plans live in the vault, never repo roots.** New plan/spec/status/handoff → `$FRIDAY_VAULT/ACTIVE/specs/friday-os/` or `ACTIVE/projects/<slug>/resources/`, linked from the PTR. Repos keep README + AGENTS overlay + code-referenced contracts. Retire = tombstone to `ARCHIVE/`.
13. **Never trust a persistence claim.** `durable:true` / "saved" ≠ durable — read the write back; verify container volumes actually receive writes.
14. **Auth fails closed.** `if not secret: reject` — never `if secret: verify`. Timing-safe compares; verify webhook signatures (HMAC), not just a bearer.
15. **Preflight credentials before any batch run.** Abort the whole run loudly on auth failure — never fail per-item.
16. **Sources disagree? STOP and surface it.** "A says X, B says Y — going with X because Z. Confirm?" Written SOT outranks recalled/transcribed notes.
17. **No undeclared nested git repos.** Submodule it, gitignore it, or move it out. Before bulk adds: `find . -name .git -mindepth 2`.
18. **Session end → distill to the vault.** Non-obvious lessons go to `$FRIDAY_VAULT/ACTIVE/projects/<slug>/learnings.md` (PR `chore/<slug>-learnings-<date>`; the distill-to-vault skill) — private agent memory is a working set, never the handoff.
19. **A tool that prints a secret has published it — pipe, never display.** Assume any CLI may print a credential you did not ask for: `claude setup-token` prints the token, and Supabase's `GET /v1/projects/{ref}/postgrest` returns `jwt_secret` beside the schema config (both hit on 2026-08-29). Redirect to a 0600 file or extract the single field you need — never let it render into a pane, a scrollback or a tool result. Once it has rendered it is exposed: rotate it, don't reason about who saw it.
20. **Clean up after yourself.** When the PR lands, remove your worktrees, test files, temp and `.bak` copies; nothing lives loose in `/root` or outside the workspace's repos; on a server, credentials live only in `friday-secrets` (a dev box may keep the gitignored `.env.local` that `vercel env pull` writes). Leave the record (PR, issue, day note), not the debris (Director, 2026-09-30).

## The learning loop (make the system smarter)
- Failure / non-obvious fix → `learning_log(...)`; recurring → GitHub issue `label:failure`.
- Reusable workflow → **technique** (scored; reuse bumps, failure down-weights).
- From cloud: INSERT into `friday_brain.ingest_queue` on Supabase (kind/payload/target_tool + `dedupe_key`) — the drains apply it.
- LIBRARIAN re-distills the brain into `projects/<slug>/learnings.md` each dream cycle; canon rules are proposed, Director approves.

## Red lines
- No exfiltrating private data. Ever. Having access ≠ sharing.
- No destructive commands without asking; `trash` > `rm`.
- Anything that leaves the machine (email/message/post/publish) → ask first.
- When in doubt, ask. A one-line question costs nothing.
